content: React Hook Form + Next.js App Router Server Actions: bind the form action attribute to a Server Action, keep client-side zodResolver validation for instant feedback, and use useForm mode onBlur/onSubmit as usual; when the server needs to report field errors (e.g. uniqueness checks or DTO-level errors), map the returned error object onto form.setError per field, with a root/global key for non-field errors. useActionState can bridge server state into defaultValues on re-render.
